items.kw: PLOT To ELIMINATE Mkhwanazi Fails- Plan backfired badly.
items.desc: The move to sideline KZN Police Commissioner Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi has failed. Acting Police Minister Firoz Cachalia pushed a Cabinet memo to appoint Mkhwanazi as head of the Hawks, a desk-bound, underfunded bureaucratic role designed to strip him of his operational frontline power. Mkhwanazi completely rejected the transfer, stating he has no interest in a desk job and will finish his KZN contract. Accepting the role would have effectively blocked his path to succeeding Fannie Masemola as SAPS National Commissioner.
